02 // Projects

Academic Work

Arduino Robotics Ultrasonic Sensor
Maze Solver Robot

An autonomous robot that navigates mazes using an ultrasonic sensor and servo motor for obstacle detection and directional control. Built on a two-wheel chassis with Arduino as the brain, it uses distance-based logic for real-time decision-making — showcasing how sensors and microcontrollers combine to create intelligent behaviour.

KEY FEATURES
🔩 Two-wheel chassis with servo-mounted ultrasonic sensor
📡 HC-SR04 sensor scans surroundings for obstacle detection
🧠 Arduino-based distance logic for directional decisions
⚡ Stable power and signal wiring for reliable performance
Read More ↓

The Maze Solver Robot is an innovative example of robotics and automation, showcasing how sensors and microcontrollers can be combined to create intelligent behaviour. The robot perceives its environment through an ultrasonic sensor and reacts to obstacles by altering its direction. The ultrasonic sensor was mounted on a servo motor for wide-angle scanning, the robot was built on a sturdy two-wheel chassis, and proper power and signal wiring ensured stable performance throughout testing.

ESP32 IoT HC-SR04
Smart Dustbin Monitoring System

An IoT-based smart waste management prototype that solves the problem of fixed-schedule collection trucks — empty bins waste fuel, overflowing bins cause hygiene issues. The ESP32 reads fill levels via HC-SR04 (EMPTY: >25cm, HALF: 10–25cm, FULL: <10cm), creates its own WiFi hotspot "SmartBin", and hosts a live browser dashboard at 192.168.4.1. No internet or app needed. Total cost: under ₹900.

KEY FEATURES
📡 ESP32 reads sensor and calculates EMPTY / HALF / FULL status
📶 Creates its own WiFi hotspot (SmartBin) — no internet needed
🌐 Hosts live web dashboard at 192.168.4.1 with collector view
🔧 Tools: ESP32, HC-SR04, Arduino IDE, Breadboard, Power Bank
